name: punk-records
description: Sync status, commands, conflict diffs and a memories sidebar for Punk Records (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, napkins, rules across projects and machines).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs the punk command, which reads and writes memory files in your projects.

punkRecords.executable.markdownDescription: The `punk` command, or its full path (e.g. from `which punk`). User settings only: a workspace cannot choose the program the extension runs.

punkRecords.home.markdownDescription: Store location (`PUNK_HOME`). Empty: punk's default, `~/.punk-records`. User settings only.

punkRecords.saveOnFileSave.markdownDescription: Run `punk save` for the project when you save one of its memory files.

punkRecords.refreshSeconds.markdownDescription: How often the status bar checks for changes (0: only after commands and saves).

viewsWelcome.contents:
The `punk` command was not found. This extension shows and runs what punk does, so it needs punk 0.4.0 or newer.
[Install punk](command:punkRecords.install)
Runs `pipx install punk-records` in a terminal. Installed somewhere else? [Set its path](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22punkRecords.executable%22%5D).

Your `punk` is older than 0.4.0, the first version this extension can read.
[Upgrade punk](command:punkRecords.upgrade)
Runs `pipx upgrade punk-records` in a terminal.

punk is installed, but there is no store for your memories yet.
[Create or clone a store](command:punkRecords.init)
On a second machine, choose your existing store's git URL to bring your memories back.

Nothing is tracked yet.
[Track open folders](command:punkRecords.track)
punk picks up CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, napkins and rules in each tracked folder.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Punk Records
walkthroughs.description: Keep CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, napkins and rules in one store, synced across projects and machines.

steps.title: Install punk
steps.description:
The extension runs the `punk` command (0.4.0 or newer).
[Install punk](command:punkRecords.install)

steps.title: Create or clone your store
steps.description:
A store is a git repository of your memories. Create one, or clone the one you already have on another machine.
[Create or clone a store](command:punkRecords.init)

steps.title: Track this folder
steps.description:
punk saves this folder's memory files into the store.
[Track open folders](command:punkRecords.track)

steps.title: Sync across machines
steps.description:
Add a private git repo as the store's remote, then sync from the status bar.
[Sync now](command:punkRecords.sync)
